COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
C482 No.516 of 2023
With
IA/1/2022(Compounding Application)
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
 Mr. Navam Mehrotra, learned counsel for
the applicants.
 Mr. A.K. Shah, learned Deputy Advocate
General along with Mrs. Mamta Joshi, learned
Brief Holder for the State.
Mr. Rajveer Singh, learned counsel for the
private respondent.
The parties to the C482 Application have
participated in the proceedings through video-conferencing. They have been duly identified by
the respective counsels, who are appearing on
their behalf.
 The dispute in the C482 Application is
emanating from Complaint Case No.1254 of
2018, "Smt. Reshma Vs. Anuj & Others" which
was a proceedings drawn by respondent no.2 for
trying the present applicant for the commission
of offences under Sections 323, 452, 498A, 504,
506 of the IPC and Section 3/4 of the Dowry
Prohibition Act, which is pending consideration
before the Court of Judicial Magistrate,
Haridwarw, District Haridwar.
There have been various other proceedings

pending, inter se, between the parties but owing
to the fact that, now the parties have resolved
their disputes and, as a consequence thereto,
the parties have arrived at a settlement on
15.05.2023, in which they have jointly made a
statement that they will be withdrawing all the
proceedings, inter se, drawn amongst one
another, which includes the present
proceedings drawn by way of Complaint Case
No.1254 of 2018, "Smt. Reshma Vs. Anuj &
Others" and simultaneously there has been an
agreement that they will be jointly initiating the
proceedings under Section 13B of the Hindu
Marriage Act for seeking dissolution of the
marriage.
The factum of execution of the agreement
has been admitted by the
complainant/respondent no.2, who while
participating in the proceedings through video-conferencing has made a statement that, as per
the settlement, which has been referred to
therein, the agreement of 15.05.2023, she has
already received a amount of ₹3 lakh by Bank
Draft No.578203 drawn at State Bank of India
and ₹1 lakh by way of Bank Draft No.578204
drawn at State Bank of India and balance of ₹1
lakh has been agreed to be paid at the stage
when the proceedings under Section 13B of the

Hindu Marriage Act is drawn amongst them.
Owing to the aforesaid statement and the
statement which has been recorded by the
complainant and which stands fortified by their
counsels, who have appeared in the proceedings
through video-conferencing, the C482
Application would stand disposed of and, as a
consequence thereto, the proceedings of
Complaint Case No.1254 of 2018, "Smt. Reshma
Vs. Anuj & Others" pending consideration
before the Court of Judicial Magistrate,
Haridwar, District Haridwar would stand closed,
subject to the terms of settlement, which has
been agreed between the parties on 15.05.2023.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 20.06.2023
Sukhbant
